name: Animal Class
description: Names the animal class (mammal, bird, reptile and so on) of the animal described. Runs on 0G Compute's TeeML model (0gm-1.0-35b-a3b).

task.instructions: Each sentence is about one animal. Classify the animal it is about into its class.

labels.name: mammal
labels.hint: dog, cat, elephant, whale, horse, bat, lion

labels.name: bird
labels.hint: eagle, parrot, owl, penguin, sparrow, swan

labels.name: fish
labels.hint: salmon, shark, trout, tuna, goldfish, cod

labels.name: reptile
labels.hint: snake, lizard, crocodile, turtle, iguana, gecko

labels.name: insect
labels.hint: bee, ant, butterfly, beetle, mosquito, grasshopper
